RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 25

An all-female panel is not evidence of unlawful bias, and raising gender without proof will undermine your professional standing. While your leadership qualifications appear stronger on paper, final appointments often hinge on interview performance, strategic vision, references, and institutional fit. 

Instead of focusing on the panel’s composition, follow up firmly on your formal request for a written statement and scoring rubric. Requesting objective feedback tied to the job specifications is standard practice. If the written evaluation reveals procedural flaws, unequal scoring standards, or a clear failure to weigh the stated qualification requirements, you can consult a union representative or legal counsel based on documented facts rather than panel demographics.
